Whole-first: the S2 record’s own movement path (#0 → #5→0) staged in order; every scene binds the S2 record (essay path + sha256 above) by its exact movement heading (verified present in the bound bytes at freeze time) plus one material record from the frozen inventory. Not corpus-complete: full per-product depth (all inventoried records as scenes) is the following fan-out.

Enrichment 2026-10-06. Per-scene moves — #0 s2-m0-horizon: quiet emergence; knows→expresses→reaches→brings to bear walks outward to the horizon's edge; 3D here — z is the horizon's reach: what is known nearest, what can actually be brought to bear deepest (the record's own 'may exist yet be unavailable here'); 17s. #1 s2-m1-capacity-absence: hold (guard — the tetralemma holds absence in the field); IS→SILENCE walks the corners, SILENCE dimming to the quietest tint; 16s. #2 s2-m2-powers-temporal: turn (vortex — the seasons turn); Spirit→Spring→Summer→Autumn→Winter→Aufhebung walks the year, Aufhebung returning bright; dispersion LFO. #3 s2-m3-possession-disclosure: hold; P0→P5 walks the offices (possession distinguished from disclosure). #4 s2-m4-trust-power: gather (potency entrusted; attract/implode); permission→selection→refusal→fitness, refusal tinted copper. #5->0 s2-m5-horizon-returns: settle — returned fitness→tightened scope→retired option→reopened exclusion; slowest speed LFO; 13s.

Pointers: stillness → guard → vortex → guard → gather → settle. Layout line throughout (the records' term rows). Automation: dispersion LFO #2 (the seasons breathe), slow speed sine #5->0.
